newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Unimed started with buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Unimed started with buy.

text.p: - John G. Kinnard & Co said Tuesday it initiated coverage on Unimed Pharmaceuticals Inc with a buy rating.

- The company's products address the needs of HIV/AIDS, endocrinology and urology patients. Its Marinol product accounts for 90 percent of the company's revenues, although it has four additional drugs in its product pipeline.
- Kinnard estimates EPS for 1996 of $0.11 on revenues of $7.4 million.
- Shares were up 1/4 to 7-1/8 in midafternoon trade.
